structured.answer: Open an account at Psagot and buy the fund "אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125". The page says about 86,045 ₪ after 10 years, but that's with its own example of 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month at 7%, not my amount.

stuck.why: The page's default 10,000 ₪ plus 500 ₪ a month was there, not my 30,000 ₪, so the final figure isn't mine and I didn't know how to get mine.

stuck.where: Fund list, the % under each fund (screens 7-8)
stuck.why: My chosen fund shows −0.04% and the others −0.37% to −0.54%. It looked like losses and nearly put me off.

stuck.where: Shekel amounts under the starred box (screens 2-3)
stuck.why: −1,030 ₪, 1,390 ₪ פחות, 342 ₪ יותר, and 1,049 ₪ twice. I couldn't tell which was a fee and which was a difference.
It starts at 79,910 with Harel and Yerushalayim, which doesn't match the 80,952 in the list. I didn't understand why it starts there.

used: Heading 'איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד'
Fund card אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125, דמי ניהול 0.1%
Summary line 'הכי הרבה בכל המחירונים: 86,045 ₪, אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125, פסגות'
skimmed: 'What if' chart and its table on screen 9
skipped: Interactive Israel / Interactive Brokers 'אין נתון' rows
unsure_meaning: colours of the bars (pink, green, orange, yellow, red)
not_found: The final figure for my own 30,000 ₪
A clear 'first step' telling me how to open the account

findings.what: The fund's tracking vs the index is shown as a minus percent (−0.04% etc.), which reads like the fund is losing money
Differences between options are shown as negative shekel amounts next to fund names (−1,030 ₪), which look like losses
Too many small shekel figures under the main result, and it's unclear which is a fee and which is a difference
The page's example amount (10,000 ₪ + 500 ₪) is used and it's easy to forget to put in your own, so the result isn't personal
Bar colours are explained only in a legend far down the page
The step chart starts from a different option and number (79,910) than the list, which is confusing
Jargon with no explanation: דמי משמרת, נאמן, 4A, MTF
